description: Consommation d'énergie électrique, en milliers de kWh, par trimestre, dès 1993 is a dataset listed in opendata.fr.ch open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Distributeurs d'énergie électrique du canton de Fribourg. Ce jeu de données présente l'aperçu par trimestre de la consommation d'énergie électrique du canton de Fribourg, dès 1993. Les chiffres des 4 derniers trimestres sont provisoires. Coverage: Canton of Fribourg. The portal files it under Énergie. Its keywords are consommation électrique. The portal shows 134 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-fr-ch-portal.
